If a crack is present customers are most likely to detect fuel odour when the vehicle is static from the outside of the vehicle. However in extreme circumstances there could be a pool of fuel underneath the rear of the vehicle which in the presence of an ignition source could lead to a fire.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the fuel outlet  flange.

richiami.rimedio: Reprogramme the gearbox gear selector module.
richiami.titolo: AUTO GEARBOX MAY ENGAGE REVERSE WHEN IN FORWARD DRIVE.

richiami.difetto: The power steering rack to oil cooler pipe may chafe on the alternator cable terminal. This could cause an electrical short circuit and risk of fire in the facia trim above the driver's footwell also an oil leak and loss of power assistance to the steering.
richiami.rimedio: Check the proximity of the power steering pipe to the alternator terminal. Cable tie the oil pipe clear of the alternator where appropriate replace any damaged pipes and alternator components. Fit a new alternator where found necessary.
richiami.titolo: POWER STEERING PIPE MAY CHAFE ON ALTERNATOR TERMINALS

richiami.difetto: When power is lost to the external indicators  the internal tell tale lamp continues to flash as if there was no fault which is in contravention of the UK requirements.
richiami.rimedio: Replace the general electrical control module with one which has modified software.
richiami.titolo: INDICATOR TELL TALE MAY NOT SHOW A  FAULT WHEN EXTERNAL INDICATORS FAIL

richiami.difetto: An under torque condition may exist in the front lower ball joint. This may result in a high bending fatigue loading of the joint which could result in a fracture of the first thread of the ball stud which then leads to separation of the lower control arm from the knuckle. This separated condition will limit steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and check ball joint security and condition. Replace vertical link if necessary.
richiami.titolo: FRONT LOWER SUSPENSION BALL JOINT MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: A component within each front seat belt buckle may have received insufficient heat treatment. This may result in unintentional release of the set belt latch if it is subjected to a loading which exceeds the standard specified by EEC Regulation 16 during an accident.
richiami.rimedio: Recall vehicles and check production date codes on both front seat belt buckle assemblies. Replace all buckle assemblies falling within the affected production dates with quality assured units.
richiami.titolo: SEAT BELT BUCKLE CONCERN

richiami.difetto: Possibility that the automatic transmission may lock up at speeds below 15mph.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new quality assured automatic gearbox.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT GEARBOX MAY LOCK UP

richiami.difetto: Possibility that the automatic transmission may lock up at speeds below 15mph.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit a new quality assured automatic gearbox.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY THAT GEARBOX MAY LOCK UP

richiami.titolo: POSSIBLE DISENGAGEMENT OF DIFF OUTPUT SHAFT

richiami.difetto: The torque of the track rod end retaining nuts may relax and allow the nuts to loosen.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and replace the existing track rod end nuts with quality assured examples.
richiami.titolo: SECURITY OF TRACK ROD ENDS

richiami.difetto: Oil may leak from the crimping on the power assisted steering high pressure hose. This could result in loss of steering power assistance.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace the original high pressure hose with a quality assured example.
richiami.titolo: LEAKAGE FROM POWER STEERING HOSE
